    def _compress_one_for_level(self, source, attachment, target_bytes, output_dir, deadline, level):
        """The explicit-level path never rasterizes PDF pages or uses tiny images."""
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        with source.open("rb") as stream:
            is_pdf = stream.read(5) == b"%PDF-"
        if is_pdf:
            return self._compress_pdf_for_level(source, attachment, target_bytes, output_dir, deadline)
        try:
            with Image.open(source) as opened:
                if int(getattr(opened, "n_frames", 1)) != 1:
                    return source, None, None
                image = ImageOps.exif_transpose(opened)
                if "A" in image.getbands() or (image.mode == "P" and "transparency" in image.info):
                    rgba = image.convert("RGBA")
                    image = Image.new("RGB", rgba.size, "white")
                    image.paste(rgba, mask=rgba.getchannel("A"))
                else:
                    image = image.convert("RGB")
                width, height = image.size
                # Preserve small originals; never downsample below these useful
                # document-photo floors. Human preview still decides readability.
                floor = min(1.0, max(1600 / max(width, height), 800 / min(width, height)))
                best = source
                for index, (scale, quality) in enumerate(((1, 82), (1, 76), (.9, 76), (.8, 70), (.7, 65)), 1):
                    self._check_deadline(deadline)
                    scale = max(floor, scale)
                    dimensions = (min(width, max(1, int(width * scale))), min(height, max(1, int(height * scale))))
                    rendered = image if dimensions == image.size else image.resize(dimensions, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                    candidate = output_dir / f"level-image-{index}.jpg"
                    rendered.save(candidate, format="JPEG", quality=quality, optimize=True, progressive=True)
                    best = self._copy_if_smaller(best, candidate)
                    if best != source and best.stat().st_size <= target_bytes:
                        return best, ".jpg", "image/jpeg"
                return best, ".jpg" if best != source else None, "image/jpeg" if best != source else None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return self._compress_zip(source, attachment.get("original_name") or attachment.get("sharepoint_name"), output_dir, deadline)

    def _compress_pdf_for_level(self, source, attachment, target_bytes, output_dir, deadline):
        from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
        try:
            reader = PdfReader(str(source), strict=True)
            if reader.is_encrypted:
                raise AttachmentCompressionError("PDF protegido: o original foi preservado.")
            fields = reader.get_fields() or {}
            signature_metadata = any(attachment.get(key) for key in (
                "signature_evidence", "signature_evidence_id", "signed", "signed_at", "signedAt", "evidence_id",
            ))
            signed = signature_metadata or any(str(field.get("/FT")) == "/Sig" for field in fields.values())
            for page in reader.pages:
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                markers = [page.extract_text() or ""]
                markers.extend(str(annotation.get_object()) for annotation in (page.get("/Annots") or []))
                signed = signed or any("/assinaturas/" in marker.casefold() for marker in markers)
            if signed:
                raise AttachmentCompressionError("PDF de assinatura/evidência preservado: compactar alteraria o hash da evidência.")
            # Clone all PDF objects rather than drawing page screenshots. Text,
            # annotations, links and page geometry must survive byte-for-byte at
            # their semantic level. Embedded images keep their pixel dimensions.
            original_text = [page.extract_text() or "" for page in reader.pages]
            original_links = [str(page.get("/Annots") or []) for page in reader.pages]
            best = source
            for index, quality in enumerate((None, 82, 76, 70, 65), 1):
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                writer = PdfWriter()
                writer.clone_document_from_reader(reader)
                for page in writer.pages:
                    self._check_deadline(deadline)
                    page.compress_content_streams()
                    if quality is not None:
                        for image in page.images:
                            self._check_deadline(deadline)
                            if image.indirect_reference is None or image.image is None:
                                continue
                            # Keep transparency and masks losslessly. JPEG replacement
                            # can degrade them even when the preview looks acceptable.
                            obj = image.indirect_reference.get_object()
                            if obj.get("/SMask") or obj.get("/Mask") or image.image.mode not in {"RGB", "L"}:
                                continue
                            image.replace(image.image, quality=quality, optimize=True)
                writer.compress_identical_objects(remove_identicals=True, remove_orphans=True)
                candidate = output_dir / f"level-pdf-{index}.pdf"
                with candidate.open("wb") as output:
                    writer.write(output)
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                verified = PdfReader(str(candidate), strict=True)
                if len(verified.pages) != len(reader.pages) or [page.extract_text() or "" for page in verified.pages] != original_text:
                    continue
                # Compare resolved annotation content, since indirect object ids
                # can legitimately change during cloning.
                def annotations(document):
                    return [[str(a.get_object()) for a in (p.get("/Annots") or [])] for p in document.pages]
                if annotations(verified) != annotations(reader):
                    continue
                best = self._copy_if_smaller(best, candidate)
                if best != source and best.stat().st_size <= target_bytes:
                    break
            return best, ".pdf" if best != source else None, "application/pdf" if best != source else None
        except AttachmentCompressionError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            raise AttachmentCompressionError("Não foi possível compactar este PDF preservando texto e links; o original foi preservado.") from exc

    def _compress_at_level(self, attachments, max_total_bytes, level):
        if level not in self.LEVELS:
            raise ValueError("Nível de compactação inválido")
        if max_total_bytes <= 0:
            raise ValueError("O limite total de anexos deve ser maior que zero")
        cap, reduction = self.LEVELS[level]
        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.max_seconds
        prepared = []
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="energetica-level-compress-") as temp:
            for index, attachment in enumerate(attachments):
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                directory = Path(temp) / str(index)
                directory.mkdir()
                source = directory / "source"
                source.write_bytes(self.media_repository.read(attachment))
                actual_size = source.stat().st_size
                target = min(cap, actual_size * (100 - reduction) // 100)
                if target < 1:
                    raise AttachmentCompressionError("Arquivo pequeno demais para o nível escolhido; original preservado.")
                candidate, extension, mime = self._compress_one_for_level(source, attachment, target, directory, deadline, level)
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                if candidate == source or not 0 < candidate.stat().st_size <= target:
                    raise AttachmentCompressionError(f"O nível escolhido exige no máximo {target} bytes e redução mínima de {reduction}%. Não foi possível atingir ambos preservando resolução útil; o original foi preservado.")
                prepared.append((attachment, candidate, extension, mime, actual_size, target))
            if sum(candidate.stat().st_size for _, candidate, *_ in prepared) > max_total_bytes:
                raise AttachmentCompressionError("Os anexos compactados excedem o limite total; originais preservados.")
            # Validation of the complete batch precedes any repository replacement.
            results = []
            for attachment, candidate, extension, mime, actual_size, target in prepared:
                self._check_deadline(deadline)
                content = candidate.read_bytes()
                name = attachment.get("original_name") or attachment.get("sharepoint_name") or "anexo"
                new_name = self._safe_stem(name) + extension if extension else name
                result = self.media_repository.replace(attachment, content, sharepoint_name=new_name, mime_type=mime or attachment.get("mime_type"))
                result.update(original_name=new_name, source_original_name=attachment.get("source_original_name", name), original_size=actual_size,
                    compressed=True, size=len(content), sha256=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), compression_level=level,
                    compression_target_bytes=target, compression_minimum_reduction_percent=reduction)
                results.append(result)
            return results
